# vaultpatch_kv_keys (Resource)

Manages individual keys within a Vault KV v2 secret path. Only the specified keys are created, updated, or deleted — other keys in the same path are never touched.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vaultpatch_kv_keys" "service_vars" {
  mount = "app"
  path  = "my-service/vars"

  keys = {
    KAFKA_CONSUMER_GROUP_ID = "my-service-group"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `keys` (Map of String, Sensitive) A map of key-value pairs to manage within the secret. Only these keys will be affected; existing keys not listed here are preserved.
- `mount` (String) The mount path of the KV v2 secrets engine (e.g., 'app_demo').
- `path` (String) The path within the mount where the secret lives (e.g., 'my-service/test').

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for this resource (mount/path).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is "mount/path". Every key found at that path is adopted into state.
terraform import vaultpatch_kv_keys.service_vars app/my-service/vars
```
